test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per Article 6 (b)(i) of the Constitution of India, every person has a right to citizenship of India, if he/she migrated from Pakistan before the ________________ and he/she has been ordinarily resident in the territory of India since the date of his/her migration.
solution:
The correct answer is __**19th of July 1948.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​__According to the Constitution of India, as per **Article 6**, if a person from Pakistan has **migrated before** the 19th of July 1948 is considered as the **ordinarily resident** in the territory of India since the date of migration.
 
• **Rights of citizenship**** **of certain persons who have migrated to** **India** **from Pakistan** **notwithstanding anything in **Article 5.**
 
• A person who has migrated to the territory of India from the territory now included in Pakistan shall be deemed to be a citizen of India at the commencement of this Constitution.
 __
 
• He or either of his parents or any of his grandparents was born in India as defined in the **Government of India Act, 1935.**
 
• In the case where such person has migrated before the **19th** **July 1948**, he has been ordinarily resident in the territory of India since the date of his migration, or
 
• In the case where such a person has migrated on or after the **19th **July 1948, he has been registered as a citizen of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **Constitution** is a set of rules and regulations guiding the administration of a country.
 
• The constitution of India is the **framework** of the political principles, procedures, and powers of the government.
 
• The Indian constitution is the longest constitution in the world with** 395 articles** and **12 schedules**.
 
• **Dr Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar **is known as the father of the Indian Constitution. 
 
• The Republic is governed in terms of the Constitution of India which was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 26th November 1949 and came into force on **26th January 1950**.
